description: This file contains an Android activity class 'AlertDialogSamples' illustrating various usages of AlertDialogs, including dialogs with buttons, lists, progress indicators, choice selections, and custom views. It provides sample code for demonstrating different dialog configurations within an Android application.

classes.name: AlertDialogSamples
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating various usages of AlertDialog with different configurations and UI interactions.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and returns different AlertDialog or ProgressDialog instances based on the provided dialog ID, configuring dialogs with buttons, lists, progress indicators, choices, and custom views.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI layout, and links buttons to dialog display actions and handlers for progress updates.

methods.name: onEnterAnimationComplete
methods.description: Logs a message when the activity's entry animation completes.
